shortDescription: Perform live or cold VM migration in IBM PowerVC

options.name: block_migration
options.description: Enables block migration during live migration. Applicable only for live migration.

options.name: disk_over_commit
options.description: Enables disk overcommit during live migration. Applicable only for live migration.

options.name: force
options.description: Forces live migration without scheduler verification. Applicable only for live migration.

options.name: host
options.description: MTMS of the target compute host. If not specified, the destination host is selected using placement policy. Required when ignore_az is set to true.

options.name: id
options.description: UUID of the virtual machine to migrate.

options.name: ignore_az
options.description: Allows migration across availability zones or host groups.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to migrate.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of migration to perform. C(live) migrates a running virtual machine. C(cold) migrates a powered off virtual machine.
